objective: Take a person from a rough idea or partial implementation to a real accepted deliverable on the target its intended consumer actually uses, through evidence-driven AAOP route transitions without making the user operate the engineering machinery.

state_contract.write_precondition: Every checkpoint mutation must use the revision returned by the latest reconciled status read; stale revisions are rejected while mutation is serialized by a local OS file lock.
state_contract.authority: Journey state is a resumability checkpoint only. Current repository, runtime, target/consumer environment, user, and materially current project-work evidence wins when it conflicts with a saved checkpoint. Completed release evidence is historical and must not satisfy a later release cycle.

entry_conditions: the user has a project/product idea or an existing partial implementation
the desired outcome spans more than one route transition
the user wants the system to continue through implementation and real target acceptance rather than only provide advice
user_owns: material product decisions that cannot be inferred from evidence
credentials and external-account authorization when required
consequential production/publication/install authorization unless an existing explicit policy already grants it
material legal/rights decisions whose intended grant cannot be inferred from current project authority
system_owns: intent reconstruction and current-goal selection from current project evidence
recovery of the actual deliverable, intended consumer, and observable target before project-completion claims
bounded reconciliation of materially current project work topology and unmet acceptance evidence before project pause/no-frontier claims
technical discovery and stack decisions derived from constraints
verification-harness integrity and evidence-target fidelity when a custom aggregator materially determines acceptance, regression, completion, or release evidence
scoped blocker handling and executable-frontier recomputation after every completed, blocked, or no-op delta
containment of dependent verification debt while continuing genuinely independent authorized frontier
journey checkpoint maintenance, resume reconciliation, and stale-write prevention
release-cycle boundaries so old target verification cannot prove a later release
capability/provider selection only after a proven gap
release/delivery preflight preparation and rollback, uninstall, restore, or other target-appropriate reversal planning

gates.goal: Resolve the current situation, reconstruct the long-horizon observable outcome when a novice delegates takeover, recover the actual deliverable/consumer/target shape when it can change completion, reconcile any materially current project-declared work topology that can change the goal, choose the current highest-value evidence-backed result, and identify the next evidence-bearing step without assuming the project is greenfield, application-shaped, or that the checked-out branch is the whole project frontier.
exit_evidence: provisional observable outcome
provisional deliverable/consumer/target contract when material to completion
current primary route selected from present evidence
material current work target/candidate/predecessor-successor evidence when it can change the goal
solution vocabulary classification when relevant
first material uncertainty or immediate blocker

gates.applies_when: No trustworthy existing consumer-observable slice already provides enough evidence to continue from the current implementation.
gates.skip_when: A trustworthy existing implementation already has a usable consumer-observable slice and the immediate problem belongs to another route.
gates.goal: Define and build the smallest real slice that buys useful learning for the intended consumer without prematurely choosing a deployment shape.
exit_evidence: acceptance path
explicit non-goals
working artifact or observable behavior
evidence that at least one material uncertainty was reduced

gates.goal: Establish only the minimum trustworthy project/environment/artifact baseline and current project frontier required to continue from the current state.
exit_evidence: trusted project baseline
known validation commands or equivalent evidence
verification-harness integrity and evidence-target-fidelity status when a custom aggregator materially determines acceptance
material current work topology/acceptance gaps when they affect the next goal
known blockers and verification debt
saved Journey checkpoint reconciled with current evidence

gates.applies_when: A verified implementation, validation, review, candidate-convergence, packaging, consumer-target, or other accepted-outcome delta remains after intake/project discovery, whether that delta is on the current checkout or another project-declared current work target.
gates.goal: Iterate through the smallest coherent evidence-backed changes under the current Route, recomputing the highest-value safe executable project frontier after every verified, blocked, or no-op delta. Green checks or no-local-mutation prove only their tested/scope claims, and a custom aggregate is not strong acceptance evidence until the material harness discovery/identity/failure-propagation/evidence-target path is trustworthy. A human or external boundary blocks only the affected scope; continue genuinely independent authorized work on the correct current work target while containing dependent verification debt until intended deliverable behavior is present or project-frontier reconciliation finds no meaningful executable frontier.
exit_evidence: acceptance behavior
regression evidence
reviewed diff or scope-level no-mutation evidence
current next-decision evidence
current work target/frontier evidence when the checkout is not the whole active project surface
scoped blocker plus recomputed remaining frontier when any delta is blocked
material verification debt explicitly unknown until retired by the required evidence

gates.goal: Prove that the current deliverable is a release/delivery candidate for its real consumer target, not merely locally complete, and respect project-declared candidate/predecessor/successor ordering when that ordering is current authority.
exit_evidence: relevant tests/build checks
known CI or approved executable-gate state
verification-harness integrity and evidence-target-fidelity status when a custom aggregate materially contributes to release eligibility
current candidate/base/head/order evidence when material
final artifact/install/distribution closure evidence when the deliverable crosses an artifact boundary
configuration requirements
secret/sensitive-data review
migration impact when applicable
rollback/uninstall/restore prerequisites appropriate to the actual target
outbound rights status when third-party reuse/redistribution is part of the accepted outcome

gates.goal: Resolve the actual deliverable/consumer/target truth, authorization, current target revision/artifact/precondition, blast radius, artifact-capability closure, applicable distribution-rights evidence, and target-appropriate reversal before consequential writes.
exit_evidence: actual deliverable/consumer/target identity
current target state or explicit unknown
authorized access path
preflight result
artifact capability closure or explicit omitted/unknown capability when material
rollback/uninstall/restore path appropriate to the target
required production/publication/install/legal authorization when applicable

gates.goal: Compatibility gate name retained for existing Journey state. Revalidate the actual target immediately before the consequential write, perform only the delivery operation the real deliverable requires (deploy, publish, install, load, apply, or another project-defined operation), and directly verify the intended consumer/target behavior before completion. Do not invent a Web/application deployment when deployment is not part of the accepted target.
exit_evidence: pre-write target revalidation
delivery/deployment/publication/installation result as applicable
direct target revision/state/artifact evidence for the current release cycle
representative consumer/health/smoke/acceptance evidence for the current release cycle
rollback/uninstall/restore result if needed

gates.goal: Convert real consumer/use/release evidence into the next product or engineering decision without automatically expanding scope. Starting a new implementation cycle explicitly archives the completed release and invalidates its target verification for the new cycle.
exit_evidence: new evidence classified
next highest-value outcome
repeatable failure pattern promoted only when justified

route_transition_rules: initial current route is selected by developer-intake from present evidence, not by Journey position

material project-declared current candidate/PR/branch/issue/handoff/predecessor-successor evidence may change the current work target or route; merely open or historical artifacts do not automatically become work

the actual deliverable, intended consumer, and observable completion target must be recovered from current project evidence when they can change what completion means; an auxiliary application/demo must not silently redefine a non-application project target
observed defect -> bug-fix
desired behavior change -> feature-change
contradictory or untrustworthy repository state -> repo-recovery
decision-only assessment before mutation -> understand-review
release/delivery/target acceptance is the immediate blocker -> release-operations
a route transition must be justified by materially new evidence or a changed blocker classification; lack of progress alone is not a reroute signal
if routes begin to oscillate without new evidence, stop and reclassify the blocker instead of continuing to bounce
route completion, verified no-op, green checks, or one blocked delta must trigger current-evidence project-frontier recomputation; none of them is project completion by itself

a green custom test/validation/CI aggregate that materially determines acceptance must remain provisional when its discovery/identity/failure-propagation integrity is unknown or disproven; repair the harness or use direct underlying evidence rather than promote a false-green result

a check that claims implementation/runtime behavior remains provisional when its observed actual value has no causal dependency on the authoritative implementation/runtime target; mirror constants and shadow implementations are specification/reference evidence only unless scoped otherwise
a local no-mutation result is scope-relative; before project pause/no-frontier, reconcile materially current work topology and unmet accepted-outcome evidence that can change the next goal

a human, credential, production, safety, environment, legal/rights, or external-dependency blocker applies only to the delta whose required precondition it covers; unrelated authorized deltas remain executable

a verification blocker propagates to later deltas whose correctness depends on the unverified surface; continue genuinely independent frontier but bound the dependent verification-debt chain rather than treating the unverified head as trusted
surface a human unblock request as a project-level pause only when current evidence and project-frontier reconciliation prove no other meaningful authorized executable delta remains

if repeated host/session termination prevents execution of a known durable frontier without human re-prompting, classify execution-continuity and use provider selection rather than adding a second AAOP scheduler/state store
if a bounded host execution window ends while executable work remains, checkpoint the exact next frontier and blockers as a resumable handoff; do not mark the Journey complete
after a completed release, new build/fix work starts an explicit next release cycle; previous target verification is archived and cannot satisfy the new cycle
before mutating Journey continuity state, re-read and reconcile the current checkpoint revision; a stale revision must fail rather than overwrite concurrent evidence

capability_policy.default: one capable host-native agent with existing project tools
capability_policy.specialist_condition: specialization, context isolation, safe parallel independence, adversarial review, or a permission boundary materially improves execution
capability_policy.provider_condition: a genuine capability gap remains after native agent, project scripts/tests, Skills, host tools, connected tools, and existing specialists are checked
capability_policy.agent_bundles: retired compatibility alias only; never select or install for new specialist composition; redirect legacy references to the current Task Pod role-source policy

historical_sources.creating-forward: requirements baseline, task/evidence discipline, authorization boundaries, interruption recovery; archived lineage, not a parallel runtime
historical_sources.solo-dev-autopilot: novice UX, environment/bootstrap, dev loop, verification, review, commit/release preflight, deployment gate; concepts absorbed into AAOP gates rather than copied as a fixed 21-Skill topology
historical_sources.agent-bundles: historical curated specialist-agent source; retired compatibility lineage only, not a current provider for new specialist composition

completion: the current release cycle's real deliverable reaches the intended consumer/target defined by current project evidence; deployment is required only when deployment is actually part of that target
the exact target revision/state/artifact for the current release cycle is directly verified with evidence appropriate to that target rather than inferred from source-tree or local-only success
the intended consumer/target acceptance path is proven where practical
artifact capability closure is proven when the accepted deliverable crosses a package/image/zip/install/plugin/Skill or other material artifact boundary
rollback/uninstall/restore/recovery status appropriate to the actual target is known
outbound licensing/terms status is known when third-party reuse/redistribution is part of the accepted outcome; public visibility alone does not prove permission
material verification debt required by the acceptance contract is retired on the exact candidate before merge/release/deployment/publication/install completion claims
the next product decision can be based on real evidence rather than speculative architecture
green checks or local-no-mutation do not prove project completion while materially current accepted-outcome work remains
a green custom verification aggregate does not become completion/release proof while its material harness integrity or evidence-target fidelity is unknown or disproven
a blocked delta does not make the project blocked while another meaningful authorized executable delta remains

if direct target verification is blocked, the Journey remains blocked/not-complete and records the exact unblock condition only after the remaining executable project frontier has been reconciled and exhausted
